# Join Lightning Mesh

> Step-by-step instructions for joining a Lightning Mesh network: a decentralized router mesh (OpenWrt routers, 802.11s backhaul, babel routing, CRDT coordination, iroh transport) with a local front desk at http://hello.mesh. Written for people and agents from one Markdown source. Every page has YAML frontmatter (id, path, status: built|partial|coming-soon, requires, next_step, verified_against) and every step is Do / Expect / If not. Only `built` and `partial` pages describe deployed behavior. Paths below are relative to this file (docs/join/ in https://github.com/WorldTreeNetwork/lightning-mesh).

Verified against commit 723b308 (2026-09-19).

## Start

- [Overview](index.md): choose a path; what works today vs not yet

## New house, pre-flashed router (read in order)

- [Unbox](house/01-unbox.md): power; optional WAN ethernet; join factory `⚡` or `Lightning Mesh`; ignore `mjolnir-mesh` backhaul SSID
- [First hour](house/02-first-hour.md): confirm `10.42.x`; http://hello.mesh; identity optional; identity ≠ admin
- [How it works](house/03-how-it-works.md): client AP vs 802.11s backhaul; `10.42` / `10.254` / `192.168.1.1`; directory as service mesh; gaps (roles, private SSID, roam)
- [Administer](house/04-administer.md): overlay SSH; WPS WAN window; Lightning Admin = client SSID only; uci name + gateway auto/never
- [Share a service](house/05-services.md): hello.mesh Services; `mjolnir-meshd publish` on-router
- [Add another router](house/06-add-router.md): matching wireless.env + manual peer ids; or full flash path

## Join with a phone or laptop (read in order)

- [Connect to the Wi-Fi](person/01-connect.md): open SSID (factory "⚡", home fleet "Lightning Mesh"); confirm a 10.42.x.n address; roaming and DNS caveats
- [Say hello](person/02-hello-mesh.md): immediate connection when online; local portal when offline; open http://hello.mesh (http only); page tour
- [Create your identity](person/03-identity.md): IdentiKey (browser-held Ed25519, soft custody); 24-word recovery phrase (BIP39 word list encoding the raw 32-byte key, not wallet seed derivation); what is shared mesh-wide
- [Sign in to mesh apps](person/04-sign-in.md): /assert consent flow; what apps learn; remembered approvals
- [Find services](person/05-services.md): Services panel; self-signed https warnings; internet vs offline behavior
- [Take your identity with you](person/06-leave.md): export and restore; what cannot be deleted yet
- [Troubleshooting](person/troubleshooting.md): symptom → cause → fix tables; shell checks for agents

## Bring a router (operators, read in order)

- [Choose a router and flash OpenWrt](node/01-hardware-and-flash.md): mt76 MT7981/MT7986 aarch64 (Cudy fleet); Cudy signed intermediates; OpenWrt 25.12.5+; keep /etc/mjolnir/ across sysupgrade
- [Install](node/02-install.md): build.sh, build-hello.sh, fleet wireless.env, review shipped authorized_keys, install-node.sh with health-gated rollback
- [Join the mesh](node/03-join-the-mesh.md): node id, `uci add_list mjolnir.meshd.peer`, start, verify (diag, station dump, routes, gossip, /api/health); no membership gate yet
- [Operate](node/04-operate.md): reach over 10.254.x overlay; WPS WAN SSH window; update-fleet.sh; names; gateway auto/never; recovery

## Publish a service (operators and developers)

- [Publish a service](publish/01-publish-a-service.md): `mjolnir-meshd publish` on the router (not `meshd`); key-owned leased names via /api/challenge + /api/name-claim; /api/directory
- [Mini-apps](publish/02-mini-apps.md): COMING SOON — accepted design (app=v1 TXT, router-fetched /.well-known/mesh-app.json, sandboxed cards, postMessage identity); not deployed
